name: fh-digihub
description: Root orchestration for local development (backend + frontend + dev infra)

scripts.kc:sync: npm run wait:keycloak && npm --prefix backend run generate:keycloak
scripts.dev: npm run infra:up && npm run db:sync && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm:dev:backend" "npm:dev:frontend"
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
